text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While passing behind the school building, I heard cheerful singing.
Pausing to look over—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
...Haaah, I guess I really stick out in a bad way...
Just the other day, my voice was echoing weirdly all by itself.
Alright, next time, real quiet... ～～♪

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Such exquisite passione...!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
...!?
Wait, what, why maracas...?!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: That fiery singing burned me right to the bone! Young lady, care to share a song with me? And you over there watching, join in as well!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the blink of an eye, maracas were thrust into my hands,
and I found myself part of a spontaneous jam session...!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: U-Um, singing in a loud voice is...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Then mezzopiano is just fine for now.
Whenever you feel up to it, let me hear that energico singing voice of yours. Come now――

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Ooooh...~âª

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
...Yes, just as I thought.
It may be a faint, fading *calmato* right now, but it's a wonderful light.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Light……?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Ah, milady.
Please, do not cease playing that light.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Your voice is a lighthouse—a melodia guiding your comrades!
That is precisely why your light must shine brilliantly to illuminate the way!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
My voice... guiding everyone...?
...If that's really true...!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Mm-hmm♪ ...Mm-hmm!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Beniiiissimo!!
Fierce passion burns through the darkness...
Unveiling a boundless expanse of brilliant light!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A powerful singing voice piercing straight through the darkness.
The majestic tones of a violin singing its praise.
Swept up in the passionate crescendo, I couldn't help butâ

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Ah, magnificent...!
This... this is a true ensemble...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
—Bravissimo!
What an overwhelmingly powerful light!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
I had so much fun too!!
To think there was a way to make the most of my voice even when singing at full power! Thank you so much!
choice_data_list: That was resolved in record time...

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Nope? There was never a problem in the first place.
I was just enjoying the musica!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
This brilliance is the very essence of your melodia.
No, it is I who owe you a resounding grazie for such wonderful musica!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Still, you had fun, didn't you?
Your maracas played
a truly passionate melodía!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
I know, let's try other percussion instruments next!
It's bound to create an even more passionate ensemble!
